Edge validation feedback may give bounded byte-exact overlapping_projection_interior_candidates; copy one exactly, choose another complete visible literal, or return unavailable. Never infer omitted source text is absent. A neutral or negative conclusion is an available result: cite the examined non-qualifying spans as counter evidence, and never return unavailable merely because no span satisfies a positive semantic condition.
